historicalCampaignPrice.observedAt: 2020 campaign page; not a current offer

models.physicalEdition: No physical version identified in the publisher campaign, NCL record or focused title search; this is not a claim that no physical issue exists.
findings: Sharp Point's campaign card links the exact book image to BOOK☆WALKER product 65875 and credits 韓智恩／莉奈; the publisher description says 380 pages and includes a behind-the-scenes video.
Sharp Point's official 2020-04-09 promotional video names Nancy韓智恩, credits photographer 莉奈 and repeats the 380-page/video details. The promo date was not used as a publication date.
The National Central Library bibliography lists title 夏日恩典: 韓智恩數位寫真 and ISBN 9789571095646 with 韓智恩、莉奈 as creators.
The direct BOOK☆WALKER product page currently returns 404. Its publisher campaign page carries an old NT$262 campaign price; no current retail price was imported.
Sanmin's live ISBN search did not return this ISBN. No other current, directly verified digital offer or physical edition was found.

The publisher campaign image was downloaded from the product-linked public page, mirrored to R2 and passed public SHA-256 readback. The direct image host rejected non-browser fetches, so the already-rendered image was saved through the browser page asset.
